newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-OSBORNE REPLACES UMAGA IN NZ TEST TEAM.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-OSBORNE REPLACES UMAGA IN NZ TEST TEAM.

text.p: Glen Osborne has replaced left winger Tana Umaga in the only change to the All Blacks side for their final tri-series and Bledisloe Cup rugby match against Australia in Dunedin on Saturday.
Umaga has been struggling to recover fully from a chest injury suffered in the test against South Africa in Johannesburg nearly four weeks ago.
He missed the second Bledisloe Cup test against Australia at the Melbourne Cricket Ground but regained his place at Osborne's expense for last weekend's Eden Park test against the Springboks.

All Blacks: Christian Cullen, Jeff Wilson, Frank Bunce, Glen Osborne, Alama Ieremia, Carlos Spencer, Justin Marshall, Zinzan Brooke, Josh Kronfeld, Ian Jones, Robin Brooke, Taine Randell, Olo Brown, Sean Fitzpatrick (captain), Craig Dowd. Reserves: to be named later.
